title: A Magazine Story
text:
Maria reads a magazine every week. The magazine has short articles about travel, food and music. Each article has many photos.

Last month, the magazine published an article about a small town in Brazil. The writer visited the town for three days. She took photos of the beach and the old market.

questions.text: What does Maria read every week?
Why does Maria probably like the magazine?
options: It has interesting articles and photos

questions.text: What can we infer about the writer?
options: She wanted readers to see the town
She did not like the town

vocabulary.definition: a publication with articles and photos, printed every week or month
a piece of writing in a newspaper or magazine
a person who writes books, articles or other texts

paragraph_translations: Maria lê uma revista toda semana. A revista tem artigos curtos sobre viagens, comida e música. Cada artigo tem muitas fotos.
No mês passado, a revista publicou um artigo sobre uma pequena cidade no Brasil. A escritora visitou a cidade por três dias. Ela tirou fotos da praia e do mercado antigo.
